paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between training step and gradient norm of a reward model. The x-axis is labeled “Training Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000, with tick labels present at 1000-step intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Gradient Norm” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick labels at 5-unit intervals. A single blue line, labeled “Gradient Norm of Reward Model,” is present. This line starts at a value of approximately 38 at a training step of 0, decreases sharply to approximately 12 at a training step of 100, then oscillates between approximately 5 and 10 for the rest of the x-axis range. At a training step of 3000, there is a peak reaching approximately 14, and another peak at approximately 6300 with a value of approximately 8.  The line appears to terminate at a value of approximately 6 at a training step of 7000.
